procedures.title: Installing Optional Connectors
preconditions: Need to connect plumbing components
steps: For ½" Bore Flexible Hose: Use AS0314 Straight Connector or Elbow Connector
For 15mm O.D. semi rigid pipe: Use WX1532 Pipework Connector

procedures.title: Warranty Claim Procedure
preconditions: Product is within 1 year warranty period
Have warranty documentation available
steps: Review warranty statement documentation
Contact Whale with warranty claim details

procedures.title: Plumbing Installation
preconditions: Access to existing water system pipework
Installation tools available
steps: Locate the existing water system pipework
Plumb appropriate supply into transom shower unit
Feed unattached end of hose through hole in housing from the front
Fit the small washer
Tighten onto the tee-piece in the rear of the unit
Check for potential water drip damage to electrical equipment and furnishings
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly plumbed shower unit with no risk of water damage

procedures.title: Pre-Installation Checks
preconditions: Installation template available
Installation tools ready
steps: Check room for shower hose retraction behind mounting surface
Verify maximum effective hose length of 6 ft (1.8 metres)
Check hose stretch capability to required height and distance
Verify plumbing accessibility
Place large washer into ferrule on hose assembly
Tighten onto shower handset
Cut rectangular hole (244.5 x 130.5 mm) using template
Drill 6 holes (4.4 mm diameter)
For hinged cover units, engage cover in hinges before fixing
Secure using six screws
Conceal screw heads with provided covers
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly prepared installation site and mounted shower unit

procedures.title: Flexible Hose Installation
preconditions: ½" NPT male threaded tail pieces
Stainless steel hose clips
steps: For ½" (13 mm) hose, attach Whale ½" NPT straight connector or elbow (AS0314)
Secure using stainless steel hose clips

procedures.title: Semi-Rigid Pipework Installation
preconditions: Whale female ½" threaded WX1532 pipework connector
steps: Screw on Whale female ½" threaded WX1532 pipework connector
Ensure pipework is fully pushed home

procedures.title: Winterization Procedure
preconditions: Shower system ready for winter storage
steps: Set flow selector to one of the open positions
Drain the entire water system
Contact dealer if assistance needed
procedures.expected_outcome: Winterized shower system protected from freeze damage
